header.contentDescription: Beam, arch and suspension bridges as 3D forms with the spans each structural type can reach

drawTextAnchored.text: the deck itself bends; doubling the span costs eight times the stiffness
the load goes into compression and out through the abutments - needs solid rock
the cable is in pure tension, and steel is strongest in tension
Each type is a different answer to one question: how does the load get into the ground?
- and the span each can reach follows from whether its main members are pushed or pulled.
